$comment: Claude Code plugins a bare `dotf deploy` installs (CLI-063, #1339).
The SSOT for the list. Each id is <plugin>@<marketplace>, the form
`claude plugin install` takes. A plugin already in `claude plugin list` is
left alone; one the box lacks is installed, and counted only when the
setup-linux.sh and setup-windows.ps1 still carry the same list hardcoded
until the cutover; tests/claude-plugins.bats fails when the three disagree.
retired_marketplaces: names `dotf deploy` removes with `claude plugin
marketplace remove` when the box still registers them, then lists again and
fails if one survived. A retired marketplace keeps re-cloning with autoUpdate
after its plugin is gone (thedotmack: claude-mem, retired by MEM-002, #1431).
None may be the marketplace of a plugin above.
